physical_state_in: Delta water distribution network and arm system
physical_state_out: Seasonal water level fluctuation delivering nutrients and sediment to reed bed
primary_transformation: Spring inundation; nutrient loading; sediment deposition; canal management
measurable_output: Seasonal water level amplitude (cm); nutrient load (mg/L N P); sediment deposition
D_parameters: WFD hydromorphological status requirements; Ramsar water level management targets; Black Sea nutrient load reductions
C_parameters: Inundation area per season; nutrient delivery to reed substrate; sediment deposition rate
notes: 145 cm amplitude (was 210 cm; -31%); 380 kt/yr N; 57% sediment reduction from Iron Gate. Structural upstream constraints.

physical_state_in: Inundated or seasonally wet substrate with nutrients
physical_state_out: Established Phragmites australis stand with root mat and initial canopy
primary_transformation: Rhizome spread; shoot establishment; root mat consolidation; vegetative expansion
typical_time_scale: 2-5 years for new stands; continuous lateral expansion
measurable_output: Reed bed expansion rate (ha/yr); new stand area (ha); rhizome density (g/m2)
D_parameters: Protected zone restrictions; no-harvest buffer zones; invasive species control requirements
C_parameters: New reed area established; rhizome density; stand colonisation rate on suitable substrate
notes: 850 ha/yr expansion; 320 ha/yr loss to subsidence; 530 ha/yr net gain; 0.25 t/ha/yr new vs 0.48 t/ha/yr mature stands

physical_state_in: Established reed stand entering productive growth phase
physical_state_out: Mature Phragmites stand with maximum standing biomass and high culm quality
primary_transformation: Annual above-ground biomass growth; culm elongation; senescence; root mat deepening
typical_time_scale: Annual growing season April-October; peak August
measurable_output: Standing biomass density (t/ha dry weight); culm height (m); culm diameter (mm); culm density
output_unit: t/ha dry weight; m height; culms/m2
D_parameters: Minimum culm quality thresholds for thatching (2.8m height; 7mm diameter); protected zone rules
C_parameters: Standing biomass accumulated; thatching quality culm fraction; total delta biomass
notes: 9.8 t/ha mean biomass; 3.2 m culms; 8.4 mm diameter; 62% thatching quality; 17.2 Mt total delta biomass

physical_state_in: Mature standing reed culms after autumn senescence
physical_state_out: Standing dead culm stock of maximum quality accessible to harvest machinery
primary_transformation: Autumn senescence; winter desiccation increasing culm strength
typical_time_scale: October-March; best January-February after hard frost
measurable_output: Harvestable standing stock (tonnes); accessible area (ha); culm quality index
output_unit: tonnes accessible; ha accessible; quality index 0-1
D_parameters: DDBRA core zone access restrictions; seasonal permit conditions; machinery weight limits on ice
C_parameters: Harvestable standing stock; accessible area; quality-graded potential tonnage
notes: 800 kt total harvestable stock; 58000 ha accessible; 87500 ha core zone protected; only 25% of sustainable quota actually harvested

physical_state_in: Mature productive reed bed providing multiple simultaneous services
physical_state_out: Provisioned services: biomass; water purification; biodiversity habitat; carbon sequestration; flood buffer
primary_transformation: Service quantification; market access; delivery of multiple co-benefits
typical_time_scale: Annual market; continuous habitat and water services
measurable_output: Annual harvest revenue (EUR); water purification value; biodiversity value; carbon credits (tCO2/yr)
D_parameters: Market pricing; carbon credit verification standards; TEEB ecosystem service valuation
C_parameters: Harvest revenue captured; carbon credits issued; biodiversity maintained; water quality service delivered
notes: EUR 38M/yr current capture vs EUR 232M/yr total ecosystem service value; only 16% captured. Phase bottleneck at 74%.
